name: Onikirimaru ~Kochou Ranbu Taimain Den~
original_name: 鬼斬丸 ～胡蝶乱舞 退魔淫伝～
source:
The forest.
One bright afternoon a young girl takes a walk.
She is pleasant to look at, beautiful in kimono and nice hair and makeup.
"Little girl..."
Somewhere, a voice calls to her.
"Hey little girl."
There's no one around.
She's alone. Not even a beast or bird has been seen.
"I am the Butterfly. Remember me now."
The strange voice sends a chill up her spine and down the length of her sword.
The sword that was once a demon, transformed by a promise she made.
The sword called OniKiriMaru.

As the forest closes around her, the girl has no choice... but to face the dance... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086430.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
森林。
一个阳光明媚的午后，一名少女正在林间漫步。
她面容姣好，身着漂亮和服，发型与妆容也精致动人。
“小姑娘……”
不知从何处传来一个呼唤她的声音。
“喂，小姑娘。”
四周空无一人。
她孤身在此，甚至连野兽和飞鸟都不见踪影。
“我是胡蝶。现在想起我了吗？”
那诡异的声音令寒意爬上她的脊背，并一路传至手中长刀。
这把刀曾是一只妖魔，因为少女许下的某个约定才化作如今的模样。
它的名字是鬼斩丸。

森林在她周围逐渐合拢，少女别无选择……只能直面那场舞蹈……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086430.html]DLsite English[/url]]
